rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something needs to be done urgently because it matters.

example.english: This matter is important, so we urgently need to deal with it and cannot delay.
example.traditional: 呢件事咁重要，我哋急住處理，唔可以再拖。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 zung6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 gap1 zyu6 cyu2 lei5 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1

rows.note: Use this when the urgency mainly comes from hurrying to finish something or meet a deadline.

example.english: We urgently need to hand in the report before the deadline.
example.traditional: 我哋趕住喺限期前交份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gon2 zyu6 hai2 haan6 kei4 cin4 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3
